Single Responsibility — Spec focuses on one feature: auto-check gating for flow-plan auto mode.; Unambiguous Requirements — Requirements are mostly measurable with explicit inputs, outputs, thresholds, and behaviors.; Complete Context — Requirements consistently pair trigger conditions (When/If) with expected shall-style outcomes.; No Hardcoded Secrets — No API keys, passwords, tokens, or secret literals are specified in code/config form.; No Silent Error Swallowing — Error paths are explicit (e.g., record reason, non-zero exit, stderr output).; Prioritize Requirements — Requirements include priority labels ([must]/[should]) for more than three items.; Impact on Existing Features — Impacts to existing commands/flow are described (flow set auto on behavior and Prelude branching).; Bounded Resource Usage — AI calls are explicitly bounded to one call with timeout constraints; no unbounded retries/recursion specified.; Changes Require Test Coverage — Spec includes required new tests and regression expectations for changed behavior.; Spec Includes Test Strategy — Acceptance criteria and explicit test targets define what to test and how (unit/CLI/behavioral paths).; Synthesize Draft, Do Not Copy — Cannot verify synthesis vs. source draft without the original draft content.; Record Unresolved Points as Open Questions — Open Questions section exists and unresolved points are not filled with fabricated answers.; Include 'Why This Approach' Rationale — Rationale is provided via Background, Design Principles, and Alternatives Considered.; Do Not Modify Existing Tests Without Approval — Spec does not propose modifying/deleting existing tests and includes preservation-oriented regression checks.; Backward-Compatible CLI Interface — Spec changes semantics of existing `flow set auto on` but does not provide a migration plan.; Exit Code Contract — Failure behavior explicitly requires non-zero exit codes and stderr messaging.
